name: home-operations-crew
description: Primary crew for the David Driscoll homelab estate. Manages Pulumi IaC, the equestria Talos/Flux Kubernetes cluster, the Dockge hosts, networking, and secrets — all in the single home-operations repository.
notes: Sole crew. The estate consolidated from four repositories into home-operations, so there are no peer crews and crew-registry.json is empty. Issues are still tracked in david-driscoll/vault, which holds no code but hosts the crew workflows.
